question:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/744861e7c7832503a1a83797af1397a765e89e18a31511d95e26591dfc9a5014.png] 

How many such nurses are there who are from India but are NOT doctors?
solution:
According to the given information:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9397676528512f61ddbc94373d395d41109c55af8994f3ee45e5653785cb8cd.png] 

The shaded part represents such nurses are there who are from India but are NOT doctors.

So, such nurses are there who are from India but are NOT doctors = **32**
